map.由免税品种收益率与税率求税后等效收益率: Tax-Equivalent Yield from Tax-Exempt Yield and Tax Rate
map.输入免税品种收益率与边际税率，求税后等效应税收益率。: Enter the tax-exempt yield and marginal tax rate to find the tax-equivalent taxable yield.
map.📖 查看「由免税品种收益率与税率求税后等效收益率 使用指南」: View "Tax-Equivalent Yield from Tax-Exempt Yield and Tax Rate User Guide"
map.TEY=免税收益率÷(1−边际税率)。只有应税品种收益率高于 TEY 时才更划算: TEY = tax-exempt yield ÷ (1 − marginal tax rate). A taxable product is only better when its yield exceeds the TEY, so compare using your own marginal rate; capital gains tax is not included.
map.比较免税（如国债利息）与应税固收品种的真实回报。: Compare the true return of tax-exempt (e.g. treasury interest) versus taxable fixed income.
map.在高税率下判断免税品种是否更优。: Judge whether tax-exempt products are better at high tax rates.
map.做固收组合的品种比价。: Price-compare products within a fixed-income portfolio.
map.TEY=免税收益率÷(1−税率)=3%÷0.8=3.75%。即该免税品种相当于税: TEY = tax-exempt yield ÷ (1 − tax rate) = 3% ÷ 0.8 = 3.75%. That is, this tax-exempt product equals a pre-tax 3.75% taxable product; only a taxable product yielding >3.75% is better.
map.不一定。低税率时 TEY 提升有限，若应税品种票面远高于免税品种仍可能更优。应代: Not necessarily. At low tax rates the TEY uplift is limited, and if a taxable product's coupon is far above the tax-exempt one it may still win. Compare using your own marginal rate.
map.TEY 通常只处理「利息税」口径。若涉及买卖价差资本利得税，需另行折算，模型会更: TEY usually handles only the 'interest tax' basis. If trading-spread capital gains tax is involved, it must be converted separately and the model gets more complex.
